import json
import os

from shop.store import connect, can_hire, hire_count


def test_can_hire(tmp_path):
    db = connect(tmp_path / "s.db")
    db.execute("insert into items values (1, 2, 1)")
    assert can_hire(db, 1, 2, 1)


def test_hire_count(tmp_path):
    db = connect(tmp_path / "h.db")
    assert hire_count(db, 1, 2, 1) == 2
    rows = db.execute("select count(*) from hires").fetchone()[0]
    if os.environ.get("HIRES_ROWS"):
        with open(os.environ["HIRES_ROWS"], "w") as handle:
            json.dump(rows, handle)
    assert rows == 1
